# #165 — CI gap: DB-backed integration tests are env-gated and never run in CI

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-19T15:09:25Z
Updated: 2026-07-06T00:47:00Z
Closed: 2026-07-06T00:47:00Z

## Gap

The DB-backed integration tests added in PR #164 (`src/tools/__tests__/lane-upsert.test.ts`, the `dbDescribe` block) are **env-gated** on `OPENBRAIN_TEST_DATABASE_URL` and therefore **do NOT run in CI** — the default `check` job has no Postgres, so they silently skip. This is the exact coverage gap that let both lane_upsert production bugs (#162) ship: mock-pool tests can't catch SQL constraint violations or Postgres param-type inference, and the real-pool tests that *can* don't run automatically.

## Fix

Wire a Postgres service into `.github/workflows/` so the DB-backed tests run on every relevant PR:
- Add a `postgres` service container (with pgvector) to the workflow job.
- Run migrations against it in CI setup.
- Set `OPENBRAIN_TEST_DATABASE_URL` so the `dbDescribe` blocks execute instead of skip.
- Make this gate required for PRs touching `src/tools/**` / SQL writers.

## Acceptance

- [ ] CI runs the lane_upsert DB-backed integration tests (not skipped) on PR.
- [ ] Migrations applied to the CI Postgres before tests.
- [ ] A reintroduced NULL-into-NOT-NULL or untyped-param bug fails CI (verify by temporarily reverting the fix on a scratch branch).
- [ ] pgvector available so embedding-column inserts work.
